title: 晨星Lorraine Tan：Anthropic估值1.7万亿，企业级AI赛道胜出
speaker: Lorraine Tan

segments.en: How is Anthropic going to do, you know, what impact could it have? Could it survive this AI trade in a what way?
segments.zh: Anthropic会表现如何，可能带来什么影响？它能否以某种方式在AI浪潮中存活？

segments.en: I think it's hard to say that Anthropic is going to lift everybody because Anthropic is on the enterprise side.
segments.zh: 我认为很难说Anthropic会带动所有人，因为它侧重企业端。

segments.en: It's very different from a lot of the companies that we see that are listed out here.
segments.zh: 这与我们看到的许多上市公司非常不同。

segments.en: You obviously have a lot more mass market sort of AI agents.
segments.zh: 显然，你有更多面向大众市场的AI代理。

segments.en: So Anthropic, we like Anthropic, we actually value it at 1.7 trillion.
segments.zh: 所以Anthropic，我们喜欢它，我们实际上对其估值1.7万亿美元。

segments.en: And we see that as being because it's got a higher margin segment of the market that is targeting, which is to enterprise side, we expect revenue to actually be able to hit
segments.zh: 我们认为这是因为其瞄准了利润率更高的细分市场，即企业端，我们预计其收入实际上能够达到

segments.en: more than 300 billion by in five years time, 2031.
segments.zh: 五年后，即2031年，超过3000亿美元。

segments.en: And as it continues to develop, it will be able to open new markets for its solutions.
segments.zh: 随着其持续发展，它将能够为其解决方案开辟新市场。

segments.en: So we do feel that Anthropic is a little bit different because it is going to focus on the enterprise space.
segments.zh: 因此我们确实觉得Anthropic有些不同，因为它将聚焦企业领域。

segments.en: I mean, compare, and you've somewhat contrasted that already. It's Anthropic with a lot of the pure AI labs that are listed here.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，比较一下，你已经有所对比。Anthropic与这里上市的许多纯AI实验室相比。

segments.en: How different are those stories? Yeah, so the question we have is you're going to have a different levels of the market
segments.zh: 这些故事有多大不同？我们面临的问题是，市场将出现不同层次

segments.en: like what we've seen, you know, with like a Microsoft, for example.
segments.zh: 就像我们看到的，比如微软那样。

segments.en: So you've got a lower end of the market, which is the more mass AI agents.
segments.zh: 所以市场有低端部分，即更大众化的人工智能代理。

segments.en: And you don't need a lot of more compute for that.
segments.zh: 而这不需要更多算力。

segments.en: Where the argument goes is that you, for the bulk of what most people need, they don't need more additional AI complexity, let's say, to complexity.
segments.zh: 争论的焦点是，对大多数人需要的大部分功能来说，他们不需要额外的人工智能复杂性。

segments.en: So for that, that segment of market is probably where you see more competition.
segments.zh: 因此，那个市场部分可能是竞争更激烈的地方。

segments.en: You've got more entrants coming in that space, margins will be lower.
segments.zh: 有更多进入者涌入该领域，利润率将更低。

segments.en: I think for the amount of money that's being spent on the enterprise side is different.
segments.zh: 我认为企业端的支出金额是不同的。

segments.en: You're going to end up with a few key players there.
segments.zh: 最终那里会出现几个关键参与者。

segments.en: And what are the winners that you see? Well, given our valuation to Anthropic at 1.7 trillion, we'd like that.
segments.zh: 你认为的赢家有哪些？鉴于我们对Anthropic的估值是1.7万亿，我们希望如此。

segments.en: We also feel that Alphabet will also be one of the beneficiaries in that space.
segments.zh: 我们也认为Alphabet将是该领域的受益者之一。

segments.en: Remains to be seen how, you know, open AI or the others fare.
segments.zh: OpenAI或其他公司表现如何，还有待观察。

segments.en: But we do feel that Anthropic and Alphabet are probably two leaders right now.
segments.zh: 但我们确实认为Anthropic和Alphabet目前可能是两大领先者。

segments.en: What else is undervalued in the Asia-Pacific going into going to next?
segments.zh: 亚太地区还有哪些被低估的领域将进入下一阶段？
